description: Trust was put to the ultimate test in January: juggling Tulane’s playoff run and his new Florida job, Jon Sumrall went shopping for a quarterback.
The sophomore JACK’s 19 tackles, six TFLs and four sacks through four games have him in the running for college football’s top defensive honor.
Buddy Martin on Buster Faulkner: I’ll be honest. This guy could turn out to be brilliant. Maybe even Steve Spurrier brilliant. But he has to earn that.
Franz Beard’s Wednesday thoughts: an Alachua County judge’s restraining order against the NCAA clears Denzel Aberdeen for a fifth year, and more.
Franz Beard’s Tuesday thoughts: driving home from Jon Sumrall’s Monday press conference, one song bridges 42 years of Florida Gators football.
Jon Sumrall wants Gator Nation to put down the poll: Florida has lost three of its last four trips to Columbia, and ‘Bloody Tuesday’ is here.
Jadan Baugh won his first SEC Offensive Player of the Week award, and London Montgomery and Bryce Lovett earned SEC weekly honors after the Ole Miss rout.
Jon Sumrall told Florida he doesn’t want to hear another word about Ole Miss, and had good news on Vernell Brown III before the trip to No. 25 Missouri.
Athlon and Phil Steele ranked Florida’s offensive line ninth in the SEC. Franz Beard on how Trautwein’s troops in the trenches became difference makers.
Eddie Gilley breaks down the five plays that decided Florida’s 52-28 rout of No. 4 Ole Miss, ending with DJ Coleman’s game-sealing interception.
A second batch of Chris Spears’ photos from The Swamp as the Gators put away Ole Miss 52-28: pregame, the pass rush, the sideline and the celebration.
Chris Spears had the sideline for all of it. His best photos from The Swamp as Florida ran over No. 4 Ole Miss, 52-28.
An MRI confirmed a Grade 1 PCL sprain, the mildest grade, in Vernell Brown III’s knee, sources told GatorBait. He may not miss any games.
No. 8 Florida’s reward for routing Ole Miss is a trip to No. 25 Missouri, which let a fourth-quarter lead get away at Mississippi State.
